references.title: DWDS: Fisch
references.supports: No Wortzerlegung; Herkunft ahd. fisc (8. Jh.), ie. *peisk-, not formed from fischen

notes.rationale: A bottom word with no Source: the noun is the base of fischen, never the reverse (ahd. fisc, 8th c., before fiscōn), so a Source fischen is wrongly claimed. Its morphemes are the Root fisch and the zero ending (ADR 0051).
